_info: Descrizioni visive dei piatti scritte guardando foto reali di riferimento (solo come riferimento, non copiate): immagini_ai.py le passa al generatore al posto della descrizione automatica.
Analcolico alla frutta: tall glass full of ice with an orange-pink fruit juice cocktail, a red grenadine layer at the bottom, an orange slice on the rim and a straw, non-alcoholic drink
Anvei d' Nadel: bowl of clear golden meat broth with many small round stuffed egg pasta (anolini) floating, grated parmesan on the side
Arancini al radicchio: golden deep-fried breaded rice balls, one cut open showing risotto tinted purple by red radicchio and a creamy gorgonzola centre, radicchio leaves beside
Arista all'uva: slices of roasted pork loin glazed in a light wine sauce with softened white grapes scattered over them
Baccalà mantecato saporito: creamy whipped salt cod spread, pale and fluffy, served on toasted bread slices and in a small bowl, a few mint leaves and green peppercorns
Bagnet verd senz'aglio: small bowl of chunky bright green parsley sauce with finely chopped pickles, capers and olives, glossy with olive oil, a spoon in it
Bandiera: rustic terracotta pan of stewed wide strips of green bell peppers, soft sliced white onions and chunks of red tomato, like an Italian peperonata, glossy with olive oil. The plate contains only this, absolutely no pasta, no noodles, no spaghetti, no rice underneath.
Barbotta: flat baked savory cornmeal cake in a round baking pan, golden yellow crust with soft onion pieces on top, cut into wedges
Batsoà: golden breaded and fried flat pieces of boiled calf's trotter, crisp crumb coating, served on a plate with lemon
Beccute: small round rustic yellow cornmeal cookies studded with walnuts, pine nuts and raisins, piled on a plate
Beef in guinness: dark rich beef stew with large chunks of braised beef, carrots and baby onions in a thick glossy dark stout gravy, served in a bowl, no pasta
Bocconcini di cefalo: small pieces of white mullet fish fillet dusted in flour and pan-fried in butter until golden, served with lemon wedges
Bombette deliziose: small round brown wholemeal sweet buns or soft cookies, lightly cracked golden tops, on a plate
Brasato di manzo alla lombarda: thick slices of beef braised in red wine, covered with dark reddish sauce of vegetables and tomato, served alone on a plate, no pasta
Brovada carsolina: side dish of shredded fermented purple turnips, cooked soft and brownish, served with slices of cooked pork sausage
Brustengo: thin round flatbread fried in a pan, golden and blistered, cut into wedges, some topped with prosciutto
Budino al cacao: dark brown glossy chocolate cocoa pudding turned out of a mould, smooth dome shape, on a dessert plate
Cacuccili sutt'ogghiu: glass jar of small whole artichoke hearts preserved in olive oil with garlic slices, mint leaves and cumin seeds, a few artichokes on a small plate
Camille: small round golden carrot and almond muffin cakes in paper cups, soft crumb with orange flecks, fresh carrots beside
Canestrelli gratinati: small scallops (queen scallops) gratinated in their shells with golden breadcrumbs, butter and halved cherry tomatoes
Cannelloni ripieni con soia: baked cannelloni pasta tubes filled with minced filling, covered in white béchamel and golden gratin, in a baking dish, no spaghetti
Carciofini ripieni alla perugina: small whole artichokes standing upright, stuffed with breadcrumbs, garlic and parsley, braised in a pan with olive oil
Carsenza: rustic round sweet bread loaf, golden crust, with large pieces of apple and pear, raisins and dried figs visible, dusted with sugar
Cefalo in guazzetto: whole mullet fish fillets simmered in a light fresh tomato sauce with basil, parsley and chili, in a shallow pan, no pasta
Cefalo in salsa: two whole grey mullet fish lying in a shallow pan in a thin sauce of olive oil, white wine, chopped parsley and garlic, lemon slices on top. The plate contains only this, absolutely no pasta, no noodles, no spaghetti, no rice underneath.
Chraima: fish fillets in a thick deep red spicy tomato sauce with paprika and cumin, Libyan Jewish dish, in a shallow pan, no pasta
Ciacci: thin pale golden ricotta pancakes, like crepes, folded on a plate, some filled with prosciutto
Ciajoncìe di ricotta e spinaci: large half-moon ravioli filled with ricotta and spinach, dressed with tomato sauce and grated cheese on a plate
Ciajoncìe dolci: sweet half-moon fried pastries filled with fig jam, golden and dusted with sugar, piled on a plate
Ciambella al mascarpone: tall ring-shaped sponge cake with a hole in the centre, golden crust dusted with icing sugar, one slice cut
Ciambelle e san bastiano: glossy ring-shaped sweet bread rolls with raisins, golden and shiny, in a basket
Ciambotta pugliese: rich fish soup with pieces of scorpionfish, monkfish, squid, mussels and clams in tomato broth, in a terracotta bowl
Cicoria ripassata in padella: dark green sautéed chicory leaves in a pan with garlic, red chili flakes, pine nuts and raisins, glossy with olive oil
Cipollata: frying pan full of soft golden stewed onion rings and slices, clearly onions, with four eggs cooked on top, bright yolks, chopped parsley. The plate contains only this, absolutely no pasta, no noodles, no spaghetti, no rice underneath.
Coda di bue alla maremmana: several round pieces of braised oxtail with the bone in the centre, in a dark meaty sauce with red onions and carrot pieces, on a plate. The plate contains only this, absolutely no pasta, no noodles, no spaghetti, no rice underneath.
Coda di vitello con piselli: pieces of braised veal tail with green peas in a light tomato sauce, in a shallow bowl
Confettura di cachi e scorze d'arancia: glass jars of thick orange persimmon jam with candied orange peel strips, a spoon and a slice of bread with jam
Coniglio nelle foglie di limone: pieces of rabbit wrapped in green lemon leaves, breaded and roasted golden, on a plate with lemons
Costine all'indonesiana: glazed fried pork ribs with a dark soy, ginger and chili glaze, sticky and shiny, with lime wedges, no pasta
Ciarabaldoni: thin round crisp waffle wafers with an embossed pattern, golden, stacked and some rolled, anise-flavoured Umbrian cialde
Crema ai porri: smooth creamy pale green leek and potato soup in a bowl, swirl of olive oil, grated parmesan on top
Crema di Cogne: smooth chocolate custard cream in glass cups, light brown, served with thin crisp tegole biscuits
Crema reggina: scoops of pink gelato with candied fruit pieces and chocolate shavings in a glass cup
Cremolario: stale bread slices topped with golden fried onions, melted mountain cheese, fried eggs and fresh watercress
Cuddhuraci: braided ring-shaped Easter sweet bread with whole eggs in the shell baked in it, decorated with coloured sprinkles
Datteri con le noci: round plate of brown dates stuffed with walnut halves, glistening with a splash of cognac
Delizia di ricotta al caffè: slice of creamy ricotta and coffee cheesecake on a crumbled biscuit base, dark chocolate shavings on top
Entrapolada: hearty stew of white cannellini beans with pieces of sausage, golden onions and green pepper in a terracotta pot
Escalope de le petit chevreau: three thin oval pan-seared veal escalopes on a plate, covered with a glossy brown marsala pan sauce, a lemon wedge. The plate contains only this, absolutely no pasta, no noodles, no spaghetti, no rice underneath.
Filet de boeuf au madère (Filetto di man: three thick slices of roasted beef tenderloin, pink in the centre, on a plate with a dark glossy madeira wine sauce poured over. The plate contains only this, absolutely no pasta, no noodles, no spaghetti, no rice underneath.
Filetti di sogliole allo zafferano: flat white sole fillets in a golden yellow saffron sauce with parsley and orange slices, on a plate, no pasta
Flamenquin de jambon: breaded and deep-fried pork rolls filled with ham and cheese, cut in slices to show the spiral filling, Spanish dish
